system.description: A spectral serpent's head lunges from your shoulder at a foe within 5'.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, 2x damage, and the foe is Slowed on its next turn.
outcomes.success: The foe takes d12 damage and d6 persistent poison damage.
outcomes.ruin: The serpent turns on you: you take d6 persistent poison damage. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
